# Fillaform

> Fillaform is a Chrome extension that fills any web form — job applications, Google Forms, registrations, and surveys — using your CV and notes. Answers taken straight from your details are left unmarked; answers it inferred are tagged "I guessed" or "not sure" so you review only those.

## What Fillaform does

- Ingests your resume, links, and pasted notes into a searchable knowledge graph.
- Fills any web form — text, dropdowns, radio buttons, checkboxes, and textareas.
- Answers written questions ("Why do you want to work here?") from your own CV and notes.
- Leaves answers read from your details unmarked, and tags inferred answers so you review only those.
- Supports Google Forms, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and a generic fallback for everything else.

- [Home](https://fillaform.in/) — overview and an interactive demo.

- [Pricing](https://fillaform.in/pricing) — Free (5 forms/mo), Pro (50 forms/mo, $12), Ultra (300 forms/mo, $30).
- [Compare](https://fillaform.in/compare) — Fillaform vs. other autofillers.

## Plans

- **Free** — $0/mo, 5 forms per month.
- **Pro** — $12/mo, 50 forms per month.
- **Ultra** — $30/mo, 300 forms per month.

## Privacy

Fillaform does not auto-submit forms, never sells your data, and never uses it to train models. You can delete your data at any time. See the [privacy policy](https://fillaform.in/privacy).
